jobs.title: Measurement Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Title:
Data Analyst

Work Location:
Wall Street, NY, Hybrid (3 days a week in office)

Start Date
: ASAP

Whalar, part of Accenture Song is the leading, most awarded Creator and Social agency. We transform brands into cultural drivers by unlocking the full creative power of Creators.

We go beyond the conventional social and influencer strategy. We have the technology and methodology to tap into the beating pulse of communities, listen to nuances that move culture, and connect brands in ways that make them unforgettable.

With hubs in London, Berlin, New York, and Los Angeles, our reach is global.

Learn more: https://www.whalar.com/

About The Role

Whalar is looking for a Data Analyst to support our Client Services team with campaign reporting. Reporting to a Measurement Manager, you’ll pull data from social and marketing platforms, build reports and dashboards, and turn the numbers into clear insights for our brand clients. Your work will show how our influencer campaigns are performing and help shape what we do next.

Here’s What You’ll Do Day-to-day

Collaborate with Client Services team to understand the diverse needs of each brand
Synthesize data from a variety of platforms and provide clear actionable insights to reporting
Aggregate, organize and visualize data to communicate effectively.
Work closely with the greater analytics team to ensure the ongoing evolution and improvement of reporting outputs
Partner with internal and external partners to measure the effectiveness of marketing campaigns and provide recommendations to the marketing team
Develop ad-hoc analysis and reports

Here’s What We’re Looking For

1+ years of work experience in a Data Analyst role
Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g. Mathematics, Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering)
Top Excel/Google sheets, Looker Dashboard, and Powerpoint/Google Slides skills
Proven ability to perform data-driven analyses including insight and action communication
Excellent presentation and communication skills; comfortable explaining technical topics to non-technical users
Strong aptitude for learning new technologies and analytics techniques
Prior digital and/or influencer marketing knowledge (Preferred)

The salary range for this role is $55,000 - $60,000 and serves as a general guideline for the potential compensation. The final salary offer will be determined based on a comprehensive evaluation of factors such as the candidate's experience, expertise, alignment with the position's requirements, location, and, ultimately, budget approvals.

Our Values

At Whalar, diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) isn't just a statement, it's our collective strength. Our people are our superpower. A diverse team and inclusive leadership have shaped Whalar since our inception in 2016, fueling a constant evolution of growth. We champion a culture of respect and empathy, fostering a sense of belonging that transcends demographics. We hire individuals of all backgrounds and empower them to thrive, challenge stereotypes, and actively break societal barriers.

Whalar provides flexible benefits and collaborative work environments/experiences, so employees can work productively in a setting that best and uniquely suits their needs.

25 days of PTO + Sick days + Winter break
Retirement planning with employer match

New joiner's Home office allowance

Volunteer days
Identity theft protection & Legal assistance
Company Paid Life & Disability Insurance

Voluntary Hospital and Critical Illness Insurance
Voluntary Pet insurance
Employee Resource Groups

jobs.title: Market Research Analyst or Senior Analyst, Technology Practice
jobs.description:
NRG is a leading global insights and strategy firm at the confluence of content, culture, and technology . We stay ahead of what ’ s next, providing fresh insights to spark new ideas . We ’ re a trusted partner to our clients, working behind the scenes to bring imagination, depth, and clarity to their biggest challenges — in entertainment, technology, lifestyle, sports, and gaming . Together, we create with confidence.

We’re proud of our company’s values – these values guide us as we navigate sunny days, gray skies and everything in between:

Do what you love. With conviction.
Where discovery lives. And impact drives.
Celebrate difference . Cultivate belonging .
Big thinking. Collectively inspired.
Embrace the journey. Be human.

The Opportunity

NRG is seeking a Research Analyst or Senior Analyst to join our Technology research practice. In this role, you’ll collaborate with some of the world’s most influential brands shaping the future of technology. Our team stays at the forefront of innovation—whether exploring what the next generation of technology might look like, reimagining beloved products, diving deep into the evolving role of AI, and beyond.

In this role, you will support a wide range of initiatives across the full project lifecycle from survey design to report delivery. If you’re passionate about quantitative and qualitative research; if you enjoy visualizing data and discovering insights with confidence; and are looking for a great opportunity to start your career where you can make an impact, this opportunity is for you !

Your Impact

Support all phases of quantitative and qualitative research projects, including research design, questionnaire and discussion guide development, data analysis and storytelling.
Projects may include methods such as concept evaluation, brand studies, content optimization tests, messaging/positioning evaluation, creative materials tests, market sizing and segmentation.
Translate data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations through visual, creative and story-driven reports.
Help drive quality control processes at each step of the research lifecycle, from checking survey programming logic, questionnaire proofing, number checking and proofing reports and presentations for accuracy.
Partner closely with internal teams (programming, fieldwork, data processing, design) to keep projects moving forward on tight timelines.
Leverage AI-enabled approaches to enhance the speed, scale, and depth of insight generation across research and storytelling.

Who We're Looking For

Prior Experience – Prior internship or work experience in market research or consumer insights .
Writing and storytelling – You know how to connect the dots and turn complex research findings into clear, compelling narratives. Whether you are writing a report, building a presentation, or presenting to a client, you bring insights to life in a way that captures attention and drives decisions.
Curious and future-minded – You are genuinely interested in seeking information on the “whys,” always digging for more information to understand what makes consumers tick. You’re constantly asking “what’s changing?” and “what’s next?”—especially when it comes to audiences, technology, and content strategy.
Consumer-to-market translator – You’re skilled at moving from consumer insight to strategic implication, helping answer the question: “So what does this mean for our technology clients ?”
Problem Solver – You are a natural problem solver. When something doesn’t go as planned, your first instinct is to look for a solution, rather than viewing it as a roadblock.
Data-driven critical thinker – You’re comfortable working with data to identify trends and insights, including both structured ( i.e. data and hard numbers) and unstructured ( i.e. interviews and qualitative) data. You have experience visualizing data with tools such as Excel and PowerPoint .
Data analysis techniques and software – Familiarity with any of the following data analysis techniques would be ideal: statistical significance testing, correlation analysis, multivariate analysis techniques (such as cluster/segmentation analysis ) and conjoint and discrete choice analysis. Experience with SPSS, Q, or advanced analytics is a plus but not required .
AI-curious and capable – You have experience using AI tools and are thoughtful about how AI can enhance—not replace—insight work.
Self-starter – Internally-motivated who continuously strives to get things done well, regardless of challenges encountered . You are proactive and always keep an eye on the next step.
Clear and proactive communicator – You have excellent verbal communication skills and are able to communicate clearly and succinctly. You’re comfortable asking questions and sharing your point of view.
Hawk-eyed attention to detail – You notice when font sizes change unexpectedly or a proper noun isn’t capitalized. Errors don’t get past you and you are always focused on ensuring high levels of quality control and reporting.
Great team member – T eam player who works collaboratively and harmoniously within a team and across teams. You welcome feedback because you have a zest for learning and growing.
Your degree(s) – You have a B.A./B.S. degree in areas such as Social Sciences, Psychology, Business, Marketing, Market Research, Statistics, Economics or a r elated field. Additional degrees are welcome!

Position Type

This is a full-time, exempt position.

What We Offer

We embrace the current era of work and what it means to be a best-in-class employer. We understand the flexibility that is required to recruit and retain incredible talent, whether it’s empowering you to do your best work from the comfort of your home or supporting you if you need to take a mental health day for self-care and rest. Below is a unique blend of benefits tailored to meeting the ever-changing professional landscape.

Flexible/Remote work with optional usage of our great offices in Culver City or New York
Unlimited PTO, volunteer days and a generous number of recharge days including a full office closure during the week of Christmas and New Year’s
Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance Plans
401K with company match
Generous paid Parental Leave
Regular performance evaluations with opportunities for promotions and merit increases
Educational and training reimbursement plan and other training and professional development opportunities
Employee perks program (includes discounts on travel, hotels, cars, fitness, movie tickets and more)
Resources available for mental health, inclusive care and family building
NRGratitude – our company-wide employee recognition program
Regular team/company events and activities including annual summer and holiday parties
Pet friendly headquarters and pet insurance options

Our Commitment

Diversity, equity, and inclusion is at the center of all our practices to ensure that NRG is a place where people from all identities and backgrounds can thrive. NRG is committed to recruiting and retaining diverse talent by supporting their growth through learning programs, internal mobility, affinity group participation and leadership development. Our differences make us a stronger workforce and enhance our creativity and innovation. We are proud to be an inclusive workplace for all and are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, federal, or local law.

Compensation

In order to comply with equal pay and salary transparency laws in various locations, we believe the target range of base compensation in all locations within the United States for this role is $62,000 -$7 8 , 0 00. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

jobs.title: IT Compliance Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

The New York Stock Exchange (an Intercontinental Exchange company) is growing its Information Technology Compliance (ITC) team, and we’re looking for an IT Compliance Analyst to help build what comes next. ITC owns the development, implementation, and management of NYSE’s risk-based IT compliance program, keeping our exchange technology aligned with Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) regulation, industry standards, and internal policy.

You’ll work directly with regulators, senior technologists, and business leaders across NYSE and ICE, gaining a front-row view into how a top-tier exchange operates. You’ll gain the rare opportunity to learn advanced exchange technology concepts and bring your own judgment and problem-solving to take ownership in a fast-moving regulatory environment, where the details really matter.

Responsibilities

Support efforts responding to external regulatory examinations and requests of NYSE’s IT systems, policies, and processes, often working across multiple business units under tight deadlines.
Own activities that keep NYSE compliant with SEC Regulation Systems Compliance and Integrity (Reg SCI) and similar frameworks, adhering to strict reporting deadlines.
Act as a connective thread between business, technology, regulatory, and legal teams to keep compliance objectives moving.
Advise stakeholders on IT compliance topics that are often technically complex, translating between disciplines.
Keep leadership informed through ongoing monitoring and reporting of compliance status.
Dig into technical assessments of new systems, system changes, and software defects, spotting regulatory, operational, and functional risk and proposing compensating controls.

Knowledge And Experience

3+ years of experience in one or more of:
IT Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)
IT SDLC or business analysis
IT audit or controls assurance
Government or industry regulator role focused on technology compliance
Equities and options markets, automated trading, or low-latency market data
Regulatory compliance more broadly, ideally in financial services and/or fintech

Relevant certifications a plus (ISACA, ISC², ITIL, etc.).
Solid grounding in IT risk and control frameworks (COBIT, ISO, NIST, ITIL) and the ability to apply them to real exchange systems.
Comfort reading and interpreting financial securities regulation.
A self-starter: you’re energized by ambiguity, not stalled by it, and you bring good judgment and instinct to unfamiliar problems, proactively flagging what needs a closer look.
Reliable follow-through: you take direction and run with it while knowing when to self-solve or escalate, never working on assumptions.
Quick to learn: you often get it the first time, ask when you don’t, and move on to what’s next.
Flexibility to be available outside traditional business hours when markets or regulatory deadlines demand it.
Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the versatility to explain complex technical topics to very different audiences.
Interest in bringing automation to compliance workflows and data analysis (Python, AI tools, etc.). Experience is great, but willingness to learn is essential.

New York Base Salary Range

The expected base salary for this role, if located in New York, is between $100,000 - 130,000 USD.  The base salary range does not include Intercontinental Exchange’s incentive compensation.  While we provide this range as general guidance, at ICE we compensate employees based on the skillset and experience of the individual. Regular full-time ICE employees are eligible for a suite of competitive employee benefits, including healthcare coverage (medical, dental and vision), a 401(k) plan, life insurance, time off, and paid leave for qualifying circumstances.

The expected base salary for this role, if located in Illinois, is between $80,000 - 100,000 USD.  The base salary range does not include Intercontinental Exchange’s incentive compensation.  While we provide this range as general guidance, at ICE we compensate employees based on the skillset and experience of the individual. Horizon Next
is one of the industry's most innovative and data-driven marketing organizations and sits at the intersection of three constantly changing landscapes: people, data, and media. Our business provides strategic leadership to accelerate growth for our clients through brand strategy, media planning and investment, and best in class analytics across all channels. As the leader in innovative business solutions, we are always pushing ourselves to understand what’s next: our next innovation, our next advancement in analytics, the market’s next media evolution, and your next breakthrough idea. Horizon Next operates with the single goal that tomorrow must outperform today.

At Horizon, we understand the value that different perspectives can bring to our clients and culture, so we strive for an environment where our employees feel welcomed, safe and empowered. Our simple recipe for success? We hire talented people (thinkers, doers, dreamers, makers), challenge them and give them every opportunity to grow.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Retail Media Strategy & Activation
jobs.description:
Kepler executes engineered marketing, where every message and ad delivered helps create a more personalized and productive relationship between brands and their consumers. We do this by acting as clients’ agency of record, as their in-house team, or some hybrid of the two – and by harnessing data and technology across all paid digital media and data-driven CRM channels.

Kepler prides itself on being a great place to work. In fact, we’re proud to share that AdAge recognized Kepler among the Best Place to Work in 2022, validating our investment in our team and our clients.

We're transparent with our employees. You'll hear updates on company financials, how we're performing against bonus goals, and how we're responding to challenges we face.
We're growing. For you, that means unparalleled growth opportunities and a role in shaping the direction of the company.
We're fun. You'll work with and learn from the smartest people in the industry and have a blast doing it.

THE TEAM

Kepler’s Strategy & Activation team is comprised of forward-thinking media architects who blend technical platform mastery with high-level marketing intuition. We design integrated media ecosystems across a variety landscapes. Our team stays ahead of data privacy shifts and emerging tech to ensure our clients aren't just participating in the market—they’re defining it.

THE ROLE

As a Senior Analyst, Retail Media Strategy & Activation
, you will be a key driver in translating client business objectives into sophisticated, commerce-driven media blueprints. You will oversee the full lifecycle of a campaign—from strategic ideation and tactical planning to hands-on optimization and insight generation.

We are looking for a "Strategic Trader"—someone who understands the why behind the how , leveraging data to tell a retail performance story, and pivoting tactics across paid social and retail networks in real-time to drive incremental growth.

What You Will Do

Partner with clients to map brand business goals to advanced retail media activation strategies across Walmart Connect, Target Roundel, and emerging commerce platforms.
Lead the end-to-end execution of complex retail media campaigns, ensuring seamless integration between sponsored products, display banners, and on-site/off-site placements.
Own hands-on activation, pacing, and optimization within retail aggregation networks, specifically requiring deep operational excellence in Criteo.
Go beyond basic metrics to analyze the "so what." Use retail sales data, digital shelf metrics, and ROAS to uncover deep consumer insights and optimize for long-term value (LTV).
Develop and execute robust A/B testing frameworks (bidding strategies, keyword match types, and creative formats) to constantly push the boundaries of what’s possible on retail platforms.
Act as a strategic consultant for your clients, translating technical retail platform updates and network shifts into actionable business opportunities during weekly and monthly performance reviews.

Desired Skills And Experience

1–3+ years of full-time experience in digital media optimization, with a clear focus on Retail Media Networks (RMNs) or performance e-commerce.
Hands-on experience activating retail media through Criteo. Strong experience or familiarity with Walmart Connect and/or Target Roundel is highly preferred.
Familiarity with managing product feeds, item-level/SKU management, and inventory-driven optimization variables.
Familiarity with retail media management tools such as Pacvue, Skai, or similar commercial ad tech platforms is a strong plus.
Proven ability to move beyond execution into "Activation Strategy"—understanding how product margins, creative assets, and retailer first-party audience segments work together.
Advanced analytical skills with the ability to turn complex Excel datasets (pivots, data analysis) into compelling slide decks and strategic performance narratives for clients.

Transparency is fundamental to Kepler’s culture. Our compensation strategy is designed to attract, reward, and retain the talented employees that drive Kepler’s growth and success. We aim to offer competitive direct compensation and a rich indirect compensation program that demonstrates the value we place on our employees and their wellbeing.

jobs.title: Investment Banking Analyst – Debt Advisory
jobs.description:
High-profile deals, major growth, the right people behind you. Grow far at Baird.

Baird offers a different kind of start to a career in investment banking, built on high-performing teams and a culture that supports your growth. Here, you’ll build skills through real transactions, close collaboration with peers and mentors, and a culture focused on shared success.

About Debt Advisory (DA)

We deliver a broad range of highly customized debt solutions across the capital structure, ranging from debt financing to capital structure advisory services for institutional clients in the United States and Europe. Our debt advisory services include growth financings, acquisition financings, dividend recapitalizations, refinancings, stressed financings, debt exchanges, out-of-court restructurings as well as Chapter 11 transactions. Our deep sector expertise enables us to optimally position companies within a sector, advise clients through complex situations and deliver solutions that support our clients’ long-term strategic objectives. We possess strong relationships with an extensive and diverse list of lenders and investors, including banks, private credit funds, private equity funds, hedge funds, family offices and alternative capital providers, creating competitive processes that optimize outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Learn by doing and be trusted with meaningful work from the jump

Play an integral role on investment banking teams, providing analytical support on financing and restructuring transactions
Assist in preparing various financial analyses to evaluate transaction alternatives, developing marketing documents and financial models and administering marketing and due diligence processes
Assist senior bankers in business development efforts with prospective corporate and PE clients

Seeking a senior consultant with extensive hands-on experience in PeopleSoft application security administration, access governance, security auditing, and user access management. PeopleSoft Security Administration

Strong knowledge of PeopleSoft security architecture, security tables, role assignments, permission-list configuration, user access provisioning, and security configuration across production and non-production environments.
User Lifecycle Management

Experience managing employee, contractor, vendor, retiree, and terminated-user access based on HR job data, effective dates, employment status, and approved access requests. Ability to identify and resolve inappropriate or outdated access.
PeopleSoft Query Security

Extensive knowledge of PeopleSoft Query Manager, public and private queries, Query Access Groups (QAG), query trees, permission lists, and controls governing access to sensitive data. Sensitive Data and PII Protection

Experience securing access to personally identifiable information (PII), employee records, payroll data, and other confidential information through appropriate roles, permission lists, row-level security, and database access controls.
Access Governance and Auditing

Experience performing periodic access reviews, user and role recertification, manager approvals, segregation-of-duties reviews, privileged access assessments, audit evidence collection, and remediation of security findings.
Security Monitoring and Reporting

Ability to develop and maintain security reports, monitor changes to user access and security configurations, investigate unauthorized access, identify control gaps, and automate recurring security monitoring activities.
PeopleSoft Security Auditing

Experience reviewing PeopleSoft security tables and access records, analyzing security changes, validating user and role assignments, and coordinating with database administrators to audit access to sensitive database tables. Knowledge of Oracle Fine-Grained Auditing (FGA) is preferred.
Production and Environment Security

Experience managing security across production, development, test, and staging environments. Ability to validate security configurations, identify inappropriate access, and ensure sensitive production data is appropriately protected in non-production environments.
Workflow and Access Approvals

Experience reviewing and improving access request workflows, approval processes, manager access, employee timesheet access, and security-related operational procedures. Ability to identify process gaps and recommend automation and standardization improvements.
Troubleshooting and Problem Resolution
A
bility to independently investigate complex PeopleSoft access issues involving roles, permission lists, query access, row-level security, user profiles, and application authorization. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills are required.
Technical Documentation and Collaboration

Ability to document security procedures, audit findings, access control reviews, and remediation plans. Must collaborate effectively with PeopleSoft functional teams, developers, DBAs, internal auditors, and cybersecurity teams.
Additional Skills and Information

Strong hands-on expertise in PeopleSoft security administration, HCM and FSCM security, roles and permission lists, Query Manager, Query Access Groups, row-level security, PII protection, access reviews, security reporting, and audit compliance. Experience supporting large enterprise PeopleSoft environments with complex security requirements is strongly preferred.
Preferred Qualifications

Experience with PeopleTools 8.59 or later, PeopleSoft HCM, FSCM, EPM, PeopleSoft security tables, SQL, Oracle database auditing, Fine-Grained Auditing (FGA), security automation, and enterprise access governance.

The Senior PeopleSoft Security Analyst must be a hands-on technical expert capable of independently reviewing and resolving complex PeopleSoft security issues, strengthening access controls, protecting sensitive employee and payroll data, supporting audits, improving security reporting, and proactively identifying and remediating security risks across PeopleSoft environments.

Job Title :
Associate Director, US Consumer Analytics

Location :
Morristown, NJ

About The Job

The Associate Director, US Consumer Advanced Analytics, will be responsible for applying data, analytics, and measurement capabilities to improve consumer and patient engagement, media effectiveness, and business decision-making across Sanofi North America. As a member of the Insights and Analytics team, this individual will serve as a strategic analytics partner to assigned brands and indications, while also helping build scalable consumer analytics capabilities that can be leveraged across the portfolio.

This role will partner closely with Brand, Media, Omnichannel, Digital, agency partners, and offshore analytics hub resources to translate business questions into actionable insights, audience strategies, measurement plans, and optimization recommendations. The Associate Director will bring strong analytical judgment, hands-on problem solving, and clear business communication to support more timely, consistent, and impactful consumer marketing decisions. This role will sit within the GTMC (Go-to-Market Capabilities) NA Organization, within the Insights & Analytics pillar.

This position will report to the Director, US Consumer Advanced Analytics and will be based in Cambridge, MA or Morristown, NJ.

Ready to push the limits of what’s possible? Join Sanofi in one of our corporate functions and you can play a vital part in the performance of our entire business while helping to make an impact on millions around the world.

About Sanofi

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities

Brand Analytics Partnership

Serve as an analytics business partner to assigned consumer brands and indications, helping translate brand strategy, media priorities, and business questions into clear analytics plans and recommendations.
Design and interpret insights for DTC/P ecosystem, impact assessment of use cases, and support on-going advancements to support AI mediated engagement throughout the customer journey lifecycle.
Partner with Brand and Media teams to define KPIs, audience priorities, measurement needs, test-and-learn opportunities, and optimization questions for Direct to Consumer/Patient campaigns. Develop performance insights that connect consumer engagement, media activity, audience behavior, patient journey Progression, and business outcomes.
Lead or support recurring performance readouts, translating analytical outputs into clear business implications and recommended actions.

Consumer Analytics Capability Development

Contribute to the development of the US Consumer Media Analytics Strategy
Support the development and scaling of consumer analytics capabilities, such as audience segmentation, lookalike modeling, patient journey analytics, media measurement, attribution, reporting, and test-and-learn frameworks.
Define and execute business requirements, analytical inputs, and success criteria for priority use cases in partnership with Omnichannel, Digital, Data Management, Data Engineering, and Data Science teams.
Design, execute, and interpret analyses of large healthcare and media datasets and translate complex data findings to clear actionable recommendations for commercial and cross-functional teams to drive strategic imperatives
Help establish repeatable standards, templates, QA processes, and documentation to improve consistency across brands and indications.
Support prioritization of analytics work across brand needs, capability-building priorities, and available team capacity.

Analytics Delivery and Cross-Functional Execution

Serve as key member of larger Advanced Analytics team, coordinating with Therapeutic Area (TA) Advanced Analytics lead to integrate Consumer Analytics workstreams with other Advanced Analytics deliverables
Collaborate with Data Science and technical partners on model development, audience creation, measurement design, test/control construction, and validation of analytical outputs.
Partner with Digital and Data teams to ensure dashboards, data assets, and analytics workflows meet business needs and support timely decision-making.
Collaborate with Sanofi Data Management and Global Digital teams to ensure robust data infrastructure and quality
Coordinate with agency and vendor partners, where needed, to support media measurement, audience activation, performance reporting, and knowledge transfer.
Engage with offshore analytics hub team members to support delivery of reporting, analysis, dashboard QA, insight generation, and recurring measurement needs.
Ensure analytics outputs are accurate, actionable, privacy-conscious, and aligned with relevant policies, SOPs, and governance requirements.

Team Culture and Ways of Working

Contribute to a team culture that values curiosity, collaboration, inclusion, analytical rigor, and business ownership.
Work effectively in a matrixed environment, balancing strategic priorities, hands-on analytical work, and cross-functional stakeholder needs.

About You

Basic Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree required; preferably in a quantitative field.
Minimum of 5+ years of experience in pharma/healthcare analytics; or commercial brand/media analytics with pharma/healthcare analytics experience.
Strong foundation in core statistical methods (e.g. descriptive statistics and probability distributions)
Experience designing and/or interpreting experiments (e.g., A/B tests, multivariate tests, holdout/control group studies) to measure the impact of commercial, patient, or marketing initiatives.
Working knowledge of causal inference methods used for incrementality measurement; hands-on experience with at least one of the following is required, with experience across multiple approaches considered a plus: difference-in-differences, propensity score matching, synthetic control approaches, or comparable quasi-experimental techniques.
Experience with one or more of the following pharmaceutical and analytics data sources/platforms:
National-level sales/demand data (e.g., IQVIA NPA & NSP)
Longitudinal HCP & patient-level claims (e.g., IQVIA, Symphony, Komodo)
CRM systems (e.g., Veeva, Salesforce)
Data management & analysis platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, Tableau, Qlik, Power BI)

Experience in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry, with analytics applied to HCP, patient, or consumer engagement.
Proficiency in SQL and/or Python is required.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's, MBA, or PhD in a quantitative field, or advanced certification in data science or machine learning.
Relevant therapeutic area experience in pharmaceutical analytics (e.g., specialty care, immunology).
Experience with specialty pharmacy/patient services data (e.g., Capgemini/LiquidHub).
Experience with media platform reporting tools (e.g., CM360/SA360, Meta Business Manager, Google Analytics).
Experience applying experimental design and causal methods to media incrementality and campaign lift measurement.
Experience working as a media analyst at a marketing or media agency.
Demonstrated experience working with 1st & 3rd party consumer data sources across key media channels such as CRM, CTV/OLV, Search, and/or Social.
Deep hands-on expertise in multi-touch attribution modeling, preferably for pharmaceutical brands.

Skills And Competencies

Strong communication and presentation skills, with demonstrated ability to conduct meetings and present independently to cross-functional stakeholders, including senior leadership.
Strong strategic thinking ability, with a solid understanding of the life-sciences industry.
Ability to work effectively in a highly matrixed environment, collaborating across multiple teams and time zones.
Strong learning agility, intellectual curiosity, and attention to detail.
Ability to think strategically in ambiguous environments and adapt as business priorities evolve.
Proven ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable business recommendations for non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated emotional intelligence (EQ) and collaborative leadership skills.

Why Choose Us?

Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team. Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.
Make your work count by supporting a company that brings life-changing treatments to millions — and is committed to doing right by patients, communities, and the planet.
Drive progress from within by helping simplify, scale, and modernize how a global biopharma business delivers smarter, faster, and more sustainably.
Support teams across science, medicine, and operations by building better systems, shaping bold strategies, and enabling innovation at speed.

As a Senior Technologist, you will be at the heart of the action, designing the systems that power our most sophisticated risk-based calculations. A true passion for data, analytics, and solving complex problems at massive scale.

Strong programming skills in Python, Java and/or Scala, and expert-level SQL.

Experience or a strong interest in applying Natural Language Processing (NLP) to data access and analytics.
A knack for solving 'needle in a haystack' problems, with a talent for debugging complex data and access issues.
Experience in the financial industry with an understanding of market risk, derivatives, and risk calculations (VaR, Stress Testing, PV) is highly desirable.
Exceptional problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and lead technical projects.
Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to collaborate with senior business and quantitative stakeholders.

, the booking travel platform for Small/Medium Enterprises, as part of the Premium Products and Experiences (PPX) team, is one of the fastest-growing parts of the business, having grown ~300% YoY. As a Senior Manager, Business Analysis at Capital One, you will apply your strategic and analytical skills to major company challenges. You will lead and team with world-class professionals to develop and test strategies that ultimately impact the bottom line. And you'll do it all in a collaborative environment that values your insight, encourages you to take on new responsibility, promotes continuous learning, and rewards innovation.

General Responsibilities:

Strategic leadership: Develop business strategies that will drive growth, profitability, and competitive success for Capital One in the face of shifting consumer and regulatory behavior
Business ownership: Have an ownership mindset, and potentially P&L accountability for a business segment. Strategic planning with a 1-6 month horizon
Leadership: May manage and develop a team of analysts. Coaching and mentoring associates throughout the organization with a goal of developing and retaining talent at Capital One

Credit Risk: Drive step-change improvements in credit performance by connecting drivers of future consumer credit trends to historical behavior, creating risk models, and testing hypotheses using rigorous monitoring and analysis

Partnership: Work closely with colleagues across Capital One including: IT, Sales, Operations, Finance and others to drive improvement in quality, volume, service, and profitability
Strategic & analytic orientation: A proven track record of decision making and problem solving based on analytics. Conceptual thinking skills must be complemented by a strong quantitative orientation, given that a large part of the business is based on rigorous analytic marketing & credit risk management
Strong business judgment, leadership and integrity: He/she should be a tenacious decision maker, able to bring a healthy, aggressive, yet responsible approach to business
Solid people leadership experience: Ability to build and leverage the capabilities of a high-performing team, as well as business partners across the enterprise. Strong executive communication skills: Impeccable written and oral communication credentials, coupled with strategic influencing skills and the ability to drive agreement through intellect, interpersonal and negotiation skills

Successful track record of thriving in a fast paced, entrepreneurial and dynamic environment. Previous consulting experience is a plus

Bachelor’s Degree
At least 3 years of experience performing quantitative analysis

At least 1 year of experience performing people management
At least 1 year of experience performing project management

Master’s Degree in Business or quantitative field such as Finance, Economics, Physical Sciences, Math, Statistics, Engineering

A globally renowned media company borne of the BBC. We make and distribute some of the world’s most sought-after TV, audio and digital content. Our ambition is to be the home of the most powerful, entertaining and inspiring stories for people all around the world.

About The Strategy & Business Intelligence Team

The Strategy & Business Intelligence team supports BBC Studios Ad Sales by driving commercial growth, business performance and future capability through strategic insight, trusted data, connected commercial platforms and high-quality business intelligence.

This role is part of the Revenue Performance team within Strategy & Business Intelligence. The function is responsible for ensuring the North Am sales teams are equipped with information and insights to enable them to maximise their sales efforts.

Working across Sales, Data Solutions, Product, Technology and Senior Leadership, the function spans many far-reaching areas of the business and uses this unique view to offer an important perspective on commercial decisions. It ensures pricing decisions and financial forecasts are rooted in robust data and the latest business context.

About The Business Intelligence Manager Role

We are looking for a commercially minded and data literate Business Intelligence Manager who is enthusiastic about being involved in forecasting, sales strategy and harnessing data across multiple systems.

This is a role where curiosity and collaboration are key. Working across multiple diverse stakeholders in a broad and complicated business means great exposure and requires strong adaptability and communication skills.

Whilst regular reporting is a part of the role, we are looking for someone who can seek opportunities in automation to free up time to analyse other areas of the business and push for change. There is large scope for up-skilling in technical skills. This role has exposure to senior levels of leadership.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

Forecasting:
Own the regular forecasting process for North Am, working with senior sales leads to gain insight into regional activity and distil the information into a robust financial forecast with a clear narrative.

Dashboard creation/maintenance:
Understand requirements from stakeholders and if necessary, collaborate with our data team to set up a data pipeline and create a self-serve dashboard on Tableau.

Stakeholder management:
Ensure that senior sales leads in North Am have the information they need to do their best work. Make sure that the systems and tools we have in place are working for them, and if not, driving change through curiosity, networking and persistence.

Team collaboration:
Work with parallel roles in Singapore and London to learn, share, and find ways to join up regional projects to deliver global benefits. Work closely with team members in Strategy and Data roles to drive projects forwards.

Market analysis:
Respond to ad hoc requests from North Am sales teams to lean on our market intelligence tools to produce analysis which might zoom in on a certain sector or advertiser. These should supply sales teams with the information they need to make informed strategic decisions or get them ready for a pitch.

Financial reporting:
Work with key stakeholders in finance and across products to deliver regular financial reporting. Once reports are understood, lean into automation to minimise the workload and improve the output of these reports.

Pricing:

Eataly is the world’s largest artisanal Italian food and beverage marketplace! Eataly is not a chain; each Eataly is different, with its own character and own theme – but all with the same aim... for our guests to:

EAT authentic Italian food at our restaurants, cafés and to-go counters

Job Description

The Category Analyst, Produce is an analytical and business-focused role responsible for supporting the performance and profitability of Eataly's Produce category through data analysis, pricing analysis, category reporting, and procurement support. This position partners closely with the Category Manager to evaluate category performance, develop business insights, identify operational opportunities, and support purchasing decisions through financial and operational analysis.

The Category Analyst plays a key role in maintaining product data integrity, monitoring category performance, evaluating pricing and margin opportunities, and recommending process improvements that support operational efficiency and business growth.

Reports to the Category Manager, Produce.

Analyze sales, gross margin, inventory levels, shrink, turns, promotional results, and purchasing trends to identify business opportunities and risks. Prepare recurring and ad hoc reports that provide actionable insights to support category planning and operational decision-making.

Analyze commodity costs, competitive pricing, and margin performance to develop pricing recommendations that support profitability objectives. Perform financial modeling and scenario analysis to evaluate the impact of pricing changes, promotions, and cost fluctuations while ensuring approved pricing updates are accurately executed across company systems.

Maintain and continuously improve the accuracy of product master data, item setup, vendor information, pricing records, and category catalogues across purchasing and merchandising systems. Audit data quality, resolve discrepancies, and recommend improvements to strengthen data governance and reporting accuracy.

Support procurement activities by reviewing purchase order activity, inventory movement, receiving records, and purchasing trends. Analyze purchasing data to identify operational efficiencies, inventory risks, and opportunities to improve buying decisions.

Investigate and resolve discrepancies between purchase orders, invoices, receiving records, and purchasing systems. Collaborate with Finance, Accounts Payable, Operations, and vendors to determine root causes, recommend corrective actions, and improve purchasing accuracy.

Support vendor communications related to item setup, cost changes, promotional planning, and product information. Develop dashboards, reports, and performance analyses that support business reviews and category planning. Present analytical findings and recommendations that assist the Category Manager in evaluating category performance, identifying opportunities, and making informed business decisions.

Identify opportunities to improve reporting, pricing processes, data quality, procurement workflows, and operational efficiencies. Develop recommendations that streamline processes, improve reporting capabilities, and support informed business decisions across the Produce category.

3+ years of experience in category management, merchandising, procurement, buying, business analytics, inventory planning, or retail operations, preferably within the grocery or food industry.

Strong analytical skills with experience evaluating sales performance, inventory management, pricing, purchasing, and profitability.

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, Power Query, and financial modeling.

Experience developing reports and dashboards using Power BI or similar business intelligence software.

Experience working with Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365), ECRS POS, SAP, JDA, Epicor, Manhattan, or comparable ERP and merchandising systems is preferred.

Knowledge of produce products, seasonality, commodity pricing, and fresh food procurement is strongly preferred.

Excellent organizational, communication, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

jobs.title: Senior GTM Analytics Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Austin TX, San Francisco CA, NYC, Atlanta GA OR Denver CO

About The Role

The GTM Intelligence team helps Cloudflare's go-to-market organization make faster, better decisions with trusted data. We work with Sales, Technical Sales, Services, Finance, and our central Data teams to make sure the people who sell, deploy, and support Cloudflare get consistent, reliable answers to the questions that matter most.

We're looking for a Senior GTM Analytics Manager to set and execute the vision for how information scales across Cloudflare's technical customer-facing teams. You'll support Pre- and Post-Sales Operations, Solutions Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, and Professional Services.

This role is less about building more dashboards or doing one-off deep dives and more about building the foundations to support true self-serve analytics. You will focus on single source of truth artifacts, strategic alignment of metrics to actions, and the data models, metric definitions, and context layers that let anyone in these organizations get a trustworthy answer that fits their needs. That person might be an executive, a frontline manager, an engineer in the field, or an AI agent working for any of them.

You'll be a technical expert and a strategic partner in one. You'll be as comfortable reviewing a dimensional model with Data Engineering as you are agreeing a metric definition with a VP of Professional Services. And you'll be our go-to voice on how analytics should change now that more and more questions get answered through AI.

This is a senior individual contributor role with wide influence and no direct reports.

What You'll Do

Define and drive a multi-year strategy for how Pre-Sales, Post-Sales, Solutions Engineering, FDE, and Professional Services find, trust, and use data, including a maturity model and a phased roadmap.
Act as a thought leader on scaling information in an AI-first world, working out how semantic layers, governed metrics, and well-built context let AI assistants and agents give accurate, consistent answers grounded in our business.
Review the current mix of dashboards, reports, and tools across these teams. Create a plan to consolidate them, retire duplicates, and move toward a single source of truth.
Define, document, and carry out the official metrics for the teams you support.
Keep metric definitions aligned with corporate definitions from Finance and Data, and resolve conflicts between teams with clear, defensible logic.
Act as the main business and technical partner to the central Data team for the stakeholders you support.
Influence and review the design of data models across systems such as Salesforce, professional services tools, product usage and telemetry, support, and finance.
Design how people get answers: self-serve access, natural-language and AI-assisted querying, embedded insights in daily workflows, and curated metric catalogs.
Set up a formal intake and governance process for new metric and data requests, including prioritization, ownership, certification, and change management.
Build trusted relationships with leaders in Sales, Solutions Engineering, FDE, Professional Services, Customer Success, Operations, Finance, and Data.
Explain complex technical and analytical ideas clearly to executives so they can make decisions.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

8+ years in analytics, business intelligence, analytics engineering, or GTM/Services operations at a high-growth B2B SaaS or technology company.
Direct experience supporting at least one of the following: Pre- or Post-Sales Operations, Solutions/Sales Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Professional Services, or Customer Success. You understand how these teams work, how they're measured, and how their data is created.
Deep data modeling expertise, including dimensional modeling, entity design, and metric layer design. You can review and challenge a data model, not just consume one.
Expert SQL skills and hands-on experience with modern data stack tools such as BigQuery, dbt, or a semantic/metrics layer (for example dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, or Cube).
Strong working knowledge of GTM and services systems data, such as Salesforce, professional services automation tools, and product usage or telemetry data.
A clear, informed view on how AI changes analytics, including semantic layers, retrieval and context design for LLMs, text-to-SQL, and agent-based access to governed data, plus the data foundations those need to be accurate.
A track record of defining and rolling out source-of-truth metrics across multiple stakeholder groups, including handling disagreements over definitions.
Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional programs without formal authority, and to influence executives and engineers alike.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including turning ambiguous business questions into precise technical requirements and back again.
BA/BS in a quantitative, technical, or business field. A Master's in Data Science, Analytics, Computer Science, or an MBA is a plus.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.
For San Francisco Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $167,000 - $230,000.
For New York City based hires: Estimated annual salary of $160,000 - $220,000.
For Colorado - Remote based hires: Estimated annual salary of $146,000 - $200,000.
Application Deadline: :January 2027

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo
: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project
: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1

This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

jobs.description:
Position:
Policy Analyst, Health and Education

Location:
New York City preferred; remote within the CSG East region considered.

The position is headquartered in CSG East's New York City office. Candidates residing elsewhere within the CSG East region may be considered for a remote work arrangement, subject to organizational needs and travel requirements.

The Council of State Governments (CSG) is the nation's only nonpartisan association of state officials serving all three branches of state government in all 50 states and the U.S. territories. CSG is a region-based forum that fosters the exchange of insights and ideas to help state officials shape public policy.

CSG East, based in New York City, supports officials and staff from its 18 member jurisdictions, which include states from Maryland to Maine, Puerto Rico, the U.S. Virgin Islands, and five Eastern Canadian provinces. To learn more about careers at CSG, and about our comprehensive benefit offerings, including medical, dental, vision, retirement, paid time off, PSLF eligibility and more, please visit our website here.

Job Summary

The Policy Analyst, Health and Education, is responsible for helping connect and inform CSG East members on health and education policy issues so that shared regional knowledge drives meaningful public impact. The Policy Analyst fulfills this objective by fostering active peer-to-peer communities via CSG East's Health and Education policy committees and developing robust policy programming that reflects the interests and issues facing CSG East's members. The Policy Analyst is expected to build strong relationships with CSG East members and partners, and helps position the organization as a trusted, nonpartisan resource for ideas, research, peer learning, and policy innovation among public officials throughout the Eastern region. The ideal Policy Analyst is an effective communicator and collaborator that equally enjoys diving deep into policy details and building relationships that help connect dots and translate good ideas into collective impact. The Policy Analyst is self-driven, exercising independent judgment under the direction of a CSG Senior Manager or Director.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Policy Committees – Staffs CSG East policy committees, working with committee chair(s) and appointed members to develop and implement committee objectives and priorities. Maintains year-round opportunities for members to learn and connect through a combination of virtual and in-person activities.
Annual Meeting – With guidance from their CSG East policy committees, develops sessions and programming at CSG East's flagship Annual Meeting and Regional Policy Forum each year. Arranges for speakers, logistical planning, and preparation of information needed for assigned sessions and programming.
Capitol Visits – Participates in CSG East visits to state capitols to engage with state officials and staff on relevant policy issues, discuss ways to participate in regional learning and discussion via CSG East, and to identify, orient, and retain appointed members to their policy committees.
Policy Forums – With support from CSG East leadership and events staff, leads the development of stand-alone policy forums of varying formats (webinars, in person summits, peer-to-peer calls, etc.) that engage members and subject matter experts on topics of interest from their committees.
Member Engagement – Develops strong relationships with legislators, legislative staff, executive branch officials, and other public sector leaders across the region, identifying opportunities for engagement and supporting member recruitment, onboarding, retention, and leadership within their assigned policy committees.
Partnerships – Builds relationships with philanthropy, academia, industry leaders, peer associations, and other subject matter experts to exchange learning, pursue collaborations, and explore possible sponsorships and grant opportunities that enrich the work of their policy committees.
Publications – Contributes to the CSG East newsletter and drafts written reports, blogs, and other media to elevate the work of CSG East, its committees, and its members.
Research – Conducts policy research and environmental scanning related to assigned issue areas; responds to member requests with concise written analyses, briefs, and resource materials; and facilitates connections with policymakers, practitioners, and subject matter experts who can provide additional insight.
Events – Attends conferences, meetings, and other events relevant to assigned policy areas. May present research and represent CSG East at partner events.
Travel – Must be willing to travel overnight for varying lengths to fulfill duties and responsibilities as needed.
Perform other assigned responsibilities and duties to support the overall mission of the organization.

Skills And Abilities

Demonstrated ability to quickly learn and synthesize complex policy issues. Expertise in every aspect of health and education policy is not expected; successful candidates will bring relevant experience and a willingness to develop new subject-matter knowledge over time.
Ability to work and conduct activities in a nonpartisan political environment.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle politically sensitive work.
Steadfast commitment to providing CSG members with timely, effective customer service.
Strong research skills.
Strong writing skills, including policy description and analysis as well as more general writing such as correspondence, memos and articles.
Demonstrated proficiency in oral communications.
Ability to facilitate complex policy conversation.
Analytical, with an ability to think critically, distill and present complex information in a concise manner.
Skill and competence to work effectively with a myriad of state officials, including high level executive, legislative and judicial officials.
Ability to work with leading experts in the state government field including researchers, policy experts, and program providers.
Strong interpersonal skills including self-awareness, sensitivity and valuing others.
Dedication to public service with an unfailing commitment to act with civility, be nonpartisan in performing CSG duties, and be a responsible steward of member and donor funds.
Ability to support proposal and grant writing.
Ability to work independently and to handle a variety of tasks and assignments concurrently while adhering to specific instructions, technical direction and deadlines.
Ability to work effectively in a highly collaborative team environment.
Self-motivated with ability to take initiative and see complex tasks through to completion.
Proficiency with technology used in office settings; ability to learn new software programs and evaluation/analysis techniques.
Flexibility and willingness to take on new tasks as necessary to meet evolving needs and objectives of organization and its members.
Hard working, dependable, resourceful and willing to work non-traditional hours, usually dependent on events.
Aptitude for managing projects.
Willingness to travel as needed.

Education And Experience

One (1) year of relevant work experience in state, local or federal government, a public policy organization, membership association, non-profit, or other relevant organization.
Experience working in health and/or education policy strongly preferred.
Bachelor's Degree in a relevant field of study or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
Working knowledge of the legislative, executive and judicial process.
Demonstrated experience and knowledge of general state government public policy, policy issues and programming.
Experience working collaboratively with multiple partners, with a preference for having worked with public officials.

Compensation

The salary range for this position, based in New York, NY, is $70,050 to $86,150. This salary range is subject to change based on work location and market conditions.

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

Interested applicants must complete the online application and include resume and cover letter.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment. Equal Employment Opportunity employer (veterans/individuals with disabilities).

Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd®, Slideshare®, Everand™, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise.

Culture at Scribd, Inc.

We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.

We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location.

So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.

This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.

About The Team And Role

The team.
Data & Analytics is building the DNA of an AI native Scribd, Inc. Bringing together Analytics Engineering, Data Science, and Data Analytics, D&A turns fragmented data and inconsistent definitions into trusted, production-quality data foundations — and builds the AI agents and analytical tools that bring reliable intelligence directly into how teams make decisions.

The role.
This role supports the pillars that own payments, identity, security as well as trust & safety systems — the foundations that let Scribd securely monetize and protect its products. It is the senior-most analytics engineering role for these pillars and a purely technical leadership position with no direct reports. You will report to the Director, Analytics Engineering, and work embedded alongside Product Analytics, Data Science, Product, and Engineering partners.

Mandate.
Give core business concepts one authoritative definition, and make sure the numbers survive a PSP migration, a schema change, or a new market launch without silently going wrong. For Trust & Safety, make it possible to say with confidence how much violating content exists on Scribd and how much of it users see with numbers that stay comparable as moderation models, policies, and review processes change.

Core philosophy.
A metric definition is an engineering artifact. We care about lineage, observability, and data quality as much as the dashboard on top — because a number that quietly breaks upstream is worse than no number at all.

About You

You are equally comfortable as the modeler and the analyst. You can build the pipeline, define the metric, and defend the number in a room full of executives.
You are skeptical by default. When payment success rate drops four points, your instinct is to go find the field that changed meaning, not to write the narrative. You have opinions about how payments data should be structured to prevent misleading narratives.
You are pragmatic. You ask what the right next version is, and you use AI where it creates measurable value.
You communicate early and plainly, and you write things down. Methodology and model documentation are part of the deliverable.

You will

Own the canonical data models for payments, billing, and subscriptions in Databricks modeled once across Scribd, Everand, and Fable so a new market, or payment method doesn't require a rewrite, and built with the next engineer and the AI tools on top as explicit consumers.
Own the KPI and semantic layer for payments and identity exposed through self-serve dashboaring/AI tools.
Extend the same discipline to Trust & Safety, owning the models and metrics behind prevalence and exposure, including evaluation of AI-generated moderation labels.
Drive quality, observability, and lineage so a regional login challenge rate change or processor routing change is caught in days, not quarters and root-cause discontinuities to separate real customer or processor behavior from migration artifacts and data quality issues.
Build AI tools on trusted foundations, grounded in certified metrics and tables, kept in sync as definitions change, and validated with evaluation sets that prove the answers are right.
Raise the technical bar, set modeling and metric conventions, influence source-system changes before they land, and mentor analysts and analytics engineers in these domains.

You have

8+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence engineering or a related discipline
Deep, hands-on payments expertise: including direct experience with processor data from Stripe, Adyen, Braintree, PayPal, or similar.
Practical experience with identity and authentication data
Depth in governed, canonical data models and semantic layers, and a track record of defining a metric, defending it under scrutiny, and versioning it when its inputs changed.
Advanced SQL and production experience with Databricks, AWS, Looker, Airbyte, Fivetran, or comparable platforms, including orchestration, transformation frameworks, and automated testing.
Experience making data reliable for AI consumption
Proven ability to influence senior product and engineering leaders and translate complex payment economics into clear business trade-offs.

Nice to have

Advanced Python and experience building AI agents or LLM-based pipelines.
Experience with trust and safety or integrity measurement
Experience with local payment methods across LATAM, APAC, or EU markets, and with stored-credential and network compliance frameworks.
Experience with on-call rotations and incident response for production data systems.

Vulnerability & Patch Management

Manage the end-to-end vulnerability and patch management lifecycle, including identification, assessment, prioritization, remediation, and validation across infrastructure, applications, systems, network devices, and the software development lifecycle (SDLC).

Deliver accurate, consistent, and actionable reporting to senior management, technology stakeholders, and cybersecurity leadership.
Use data analytics, advanced Excel, Power Query, Power BI, scripting, and AI-enabled automation to streamline manual processes, improve data quality, and enhance operational efficiency.
Translate complex technical findings into clear, actionable insights and strategic recommendations for stakeholders.

5–9 years of relevant experience in vulnerability management, patch management, cybersecurity operations, IT risk, or a related information security role.

Demonstrated experience managing vulnerability identification, scanning, risk assessment, remediation tracking, patch deployment, SLA monitoring, and POA&Ms.

Hands-on experience with Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) tools, including alert analysis, dashboard development, and security reporting.

Experience conducting vulnerability scans, assessing findings, coordinating remediation, and validating treatment outcomes.

Governance & Documentation:
Understanding of internal controls, security policies, audit requirements, and the development and maintenance of procedures, process manuals, playbooks, and runbooks.

Strong analytical, interpersonal, and communication skills, with the ability to present technical findings and recommendations to management and collaborate effectively across geographically distributed teams.

Cloaked is building a cyber expert at your side - one that watches, advises, and acts to keep you safe and private in the age of AI. 600k+ paying members already use Cloaked to take back control of their data, their identity, and who can reach them: masked emails, phone numbers, and payment cards, data removal from broker sites, and an AI voice agent that screens calls before they ring through.

Backed by a $375M Series B, we're now building the agents that turn detection into action - for individuals, families, and the companies that want to protect their people.

About The Role

We're looking for an Analytics Engineer
to own the semantic layer at Cloaked - the governed set of metrics, entities, and relationships behind every dashboard, self-serve analysis, and AI-driven answer across the company. Every number at Cloaked should mean the same thing, no matter who asks or which tool they use. You'll make that true.

This is a builder's role. You'll turn ambiguous business questions into durable, well-tested definitions that both people and AI agents can rely on, working closely with the Data team and partners across Product, Growth, Finance, and CX.

What will you do?

Design, build, and maintain the semantic layer, including metric definitions, dimensions, joins, and entity relationships across product, subscription, and lifecycle data
Build and maintain BI artifacts - models, explores, and dashboards - on top of the semantic layer for teams across the company
Build and curate certified metrics and queries that power AI-assisted, natural-language data querying, and improve answer accuracy over time
Partner with stakeholders to resolve conflicting metric definitions and document the agreed source of truth
Write clean, tested, version-controlled SQL and transformation code with data quality checks and clear documentation
Work closely with data engineering on upstream models, and with analysts on how the layer gets used

What skills and experiences will help you?

3-5 years of experience in analytics engineering, BI engineering, or a closely related role
Strong SQL and solid dimensional data modeling skills
Hands-on experience building semantic models in a tool like Looker (LookML), Omni, dbt Semantic Layer, or Cube (we care more about the modeling fundamentals than any specific tool)
Experience with dbt or a similar transformation framework, Git-based workflows, and code review
Familiarity with cloud data platforms (AWS/Athena, Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar)
AI-forward: you use AI tooling (Claude, ChatGPT, and others) fluently to ship faster, and you're excited to structure data that AI agents query directly. Experience building semantic models for LLM-driven analytics is a plus, not a requirement
Clear communication, and comfort pushing back on a vague metric until it's well defined

What do we like?

Demand Clarity - push back on a vague metric until it's well defined. Then…
Build Value - we ship insights and value to our stakeholders over fancy tech / dashboards.
A value add mindset. Cloaked is hungry for insights. We must feed everyone with data.
Startup or growth-stage company experience
Care and respect for our customers' privacy as if it were your own
“Work hard and be nice to people” is a way of working. Not nice to have.

What we offer

Cloaked is a well-funded Series B startup based out of NYC.

Although we are a distributed team, the NYC team operates with a hybrid model. We have two floors of our building, with two state of the art kitchens packed with drinks, snacks and everything else you'd need to get through the day.

The Cloaked team has diverse interests and so we frequently embark on team outings and go out for socials!

If you’re the kind of person who sees a broken process and can’t rest until it’s been rebuilt from the ground up—this role was made for you.

What You’ll Own & Drive

Tear apart end-to-end workflows across content creation, production, QA, and release—then redesign them for radical efficiency, eliminating handoff waste and compressing cycle times.

Architect next-generation operating models and workflow blueprints that become the gold standard across Pearson’s product portfolio—not incremental tweaks, but step-change transformations.

Be the tip of the spear on AI-native workflow design—identify and implement high-impact automation opportunities using generative AI, agentic AI, and intelligent tooling to replace manual, error-prone work with scalable, self-improving systems.

Drive the delivery of digital content and online course programs with urgency and accountability—owning outcomes, not just timelines.

Own the full initiative lifecycle—planning, dependency mapping, risk mitigation, and delivery health—with a bias toward unblocking teams and accelerating momentum, not administering status reports.

Rally and align matrixed, cross-functional teams around shared transformation goals—building coalitions, not just coordinating calendars.

Lead high-energy workshops, transformation sprints, and workflow deep dives that produce concrete, implementable change—not slide decks that gather dust.

Hunt for and unlock cross-Business Unit synergies—reusable patterns, shared tooling, and common operating models that multiply impact beyond any single team.

Establish transparent, data-driven progress tracking that keeps transformation initiatives honest and on the rails—surfacing risks early and driving corrective action fast.

What Makes You a Fit

Deep expertise in workflow design, process transformation, and operating model architecture—you’ve redesigned how work gets done, not just documented it.

Provide thought leadership in various initiatives/projects
